text: The Verdict type must have exactly four values: CONFLICT, COMPLIANT, UNCLEAR and ADR-OVERTAKEN.
quote: `Verdict` has four values: CONFLICT, COMPLIANT, UNCLEAR and ADR-OVERTAKEN.

text: UNCLEAR must be reported as a first-class result together with its reason.
quote: UNCLEAR is a first-class result, reported with its reason.

text: When the judge errors, times out or returns unparseable output, the finding must be UNCLEAR with a reason beginning `judge error`.
quote: A judge that errors, times out or returns unparseable output yields an UNCLEAR finding whose reason begins `judge error`

text: A judge error, timeout or unparseable output must never yield a COMPLIANT verdict.
Only a CONFLICT verdict may make `adrcheck check` exit non-zero under `--fail-on conflict`.
quote: Only CONFLICT can make `adrcheck check` exit non-zero under `--fail-on conflict`.

text: UNCLEAR, COMPLIANT and ADR-OVERTAKEN verdicts must not cause a non-zero exit under `--fail-on conflict`, including when the model is unreachable.
quote: An unreachable model cannot turn a build green by accident, and cannot turn it red either.

text: The report must show UNCLEAR counts so a run that abstained on everything is visible as such.
quote: The report must show UNCLEAR counts so a run that abstained on everything is visible as such.
